p: brake the images in pieces: According to the commandment of the Lord, De 7:25, Jos 7:12.
children of Israel returned: That is, all they who came to the passover.
tents of the LORD: That is, in the temple where they assembled as in a tent.
portion of the priests and the: The tithes and firstfruits for the maintenance of the priests and Levites.
encouraged in the law of the: That their minds might not be entangled with provision of worldly things, but that they might wholly and cheerfully serve the Lord.
which were consecrated unto the LORD: Which they had dedicated to the Lord by a vow.
heaps: For the relief of the priests, Levites, widows, pupils, fatherless, strangers, and such as were in need.
blessed the LORD: They praised the Lord and prayed for all prosperity to his people.

had enough to eat: He shows that this plenteous liberality is expedient for the maintenance of the ministers and that God therefore prospers his people and increases by his blessing that which is given.
from three years old and upward: Who had also a portion and allowance in this distribution.

set office they sanctified themselves in: Meaning, that either by the faithful distribution of the officers, everyone had their part in the things that were offered, or else that their wives and children were relieved, because the Levites were faithful in their office, and so depended on them.
